llm.notes: The launcher will use localPath when the GGUF exists; otherwise it passes hfSpecifier to llama.cpp -hf so llama.cpp can download/cache the model. Replace hfSpecifier/localPath with the exact Gemma E4B-it GGUF you decide to ship.

asr.notes: Use tiny/base/small for low-end machines; use large-v3-turbo for best quality on CUDA.

tts.notes: The WebSocket TTS server still uses your current faster-qwen3/Qwen adapter. CUDA pack uses faster-qwen3 when available.
